Government to Release New Airfare Rules Amid High Fuel Prices

The Civil Aviation Ministry is holding discussions to address high Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) prices and maintain reasonable airfares. The government informed the Supreme Court that new rules concerning airfares will be published within two weeks.
